subject: Partner-led discovery - next steps / schedule demo technical deep dive
messages:
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@cloudbridge.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme-gsi.com>

Subject: Partner-led discovery - quick recap and proposed next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from CloudBridge's side:
- Use case: marketplace listing + joint demo for our enterprise customers (GSI enablement).
- Success metrics: marketplace onboard in Q3, initial joint pilots with 2 customers by Q4.
- Technical constraints: customer environments run on GCP with private networking; we'll need a short infra checklist before the demo.

Next steps we'd like to align on:
1) Schedule a partner-led technical deep dive (60 min) for Redwood runtime + integration flow.
2) Include Redwood infra/tech (Camila) and partner GSI lead (Tom) on the call.
3) Share a very short agenda and any environment docs in advance.

We have availability this week: Wed 6/17 9:00-11:00 PT or Thu 6/18 13:00-16:00 PT. Do either work for you and the team? I've attached our partner deck and environment overview for context.

Thanks - happy to coordinate calendar once you confirm a slot.

Best,
Sarah Jones
Partnerships, CloudBridge

Attachments:
- CloudBridge-Partner-Deck.pdf (application/pdf stub)
- CloudBridge-Environment-Overview.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet stub)

Thanks Sarah - great call. Wed 6/17 9:00-10:00 PT works for us. I'm looping in Mateo (partner ops) and Camila (technical lead) to confirm, and attaching a proposed 60-minute agenda below:

Agenda (60 minutes):
- 5 min intros & objectives (Marissa / Sarah)
- 20 min Redwood runtime overview + marketplace integration patterns (Camila)
- 20 min GSI/CloudBridge deployment expectations & networking checklist (Tom / Sarah)
- 10 min Q&A + next steps (all)

Camila - can you confirm availability for 6/17 09:00 PT and whether you'd like any specific artifacts from CloudBridge ahead of time?

Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks - confirmed for 6/17 09:00 PT, please send the calendar invite. A couple quick asks so we can make the deep dive efficient:
- Can CloudBridge share a one-page network diagram or a short list of outbound endpoints that need to be whitelisted? (I've flagged the key points in the attached environment doc.)
- Which GSI customers / sample workloads should we use for the demo? Demo will be more effective with 1-2 concrete scenarios.
- I'll prepare a short slide on quantization/latency expectations across typical marketplace configs - if you have token/seq length expectations, send them over.

I'll be presenting from Redwood's infra team; Mateo, Marissa - let me know if you'd like me to include any additional detail (SLA, data handling notes).

Thanks,
